title: Chapter 18 The End Of Acid Rain
content:
Chapter 18 The End Of Acid Rain

Wang Shuo turned to the original source.

"I have a way to end the acid rain. If you want me to end this acid rain, all players must pay me 1 wood or 1 stone."

"Are you threatening us?"

"Tian Hui, right! You are trapped in the shelter by acid rain. Solving the acid rain problem only gives you a greater chance of survival. Why should we pay the price?"

"That's right, we can't even afford to eat, and you still have the nerve to ask us for resources."

Tian Hui: "If I solve the acid rain, will you benefit? Why should I be responsible for the You serve, if you don't give me resources, we'll just waste them!"

"Shameless, you are simply the scum of humanity!"

"Selfish, I bet you won't live past tomorrow with a piece of dried meat."

"For the sake of humanity, I advise you to tell me the method for free, it will be good for everyone."

"Boy, don't let me find you, trash like you, I'll beat you every time I see you."

...

Seeing Tian Hui being scolded like a street rat, Wang Shuo felt that he deserved it. At this time, he dared to openly collect protection fees, isn't this courting death?

Suddenly, Wang Shuo realized that he seemed to have an important prop, still gathering dust in the warehouse.

He took out the "Weather Change Scroll", which was a system reward when he upgraded to level 2, opened the scroll, and read the instructions on it carefully.

[Weather Change Scroll: After use, you can change the current weather and randomly generate another weather. Do you want to use it?]

Wang Shuo was a little entangled.

He is now in the same embarrassing situation as Tian Hui.

Just use it directly, it feels a bit of a loss. No, it's not that big of a deal, after all, it's good for everyone.

After hesitating for a while, he chose to use it directly.

He was too lazy to go to the [chat channel] to get scolded.

After using it, the acid rain in the sky stopped almost in the blink of an eye, and turned into a sunny day with bright sunshine.

Wang Shuo walked out of the house, and the sun made him warm, but soon Wang Shuo couldn't stand the heat.

He quickly took off his cotton clothes, and the temperature was still rising, so Wang Shuo had to hide back in the house.

"Damn, what's going on, why is the sky clearing up."

"Is it Comrade Tian Hui who felt everyone's expectations of him and then found his conscience?"

"Look, I see the sun. Woo, I miss the sun so much..."

"Just for a while, I'm almost sunburned, this sun is very poisonous!"

"Don't be ungrateful upstairs, it's better than acid rain."

The sun came out, making Tian Hui a little puzzled, I didn't do anything!

In fact, he had no ability to end the acid rain. What he said in the [chat channel] before was all lies. He just wanted to get some resources for free.

Each person has one unit of resources, which is not much, but a little bit adds up to a lot, and for him, it is a lot.

After all, now that everyone can't see each other, other players can't follow the system to beat him. When the development is good in the later stage, he doesn't have to be afraid of anyone.

"Haha... I can finally go out to collect resources again, and I don't have to starve to death."

Wang Shuo also took off his cotton coat, took the necessary weapons and some tools, and planned to go out to collect resources.

The scorching sun soon made Wang Shuo a little unbearable, so he simply found a piece of coarse cloth and wrapped his whole head to avoid being exposed to the sun.

The first place he went was the flax field.

This place has flax, fish, and clay. These resources are very important to Wang Shuo.

And it is not difficult to obtain.

The speed at which he used skills to collect supplies is absolutely unimaginable for other players.

Now his mental power limit is 130. Each time he uses "muddy water", he only needs to consume 1 point of mental power, and he can recover 6 points naturally in 1 minute. In addition, he has the bonus of the rebound necklace, which can recover 6 more points in 1 minute.

It can be said that there is no need to worry about insufficient mental power when using this low-level skill.

It was a rare good afternoon, and other players seemed to be scrambling for resources.

Bai Yiming, at this moment, simply turned into a lumberjack. With one axe, a big tree was cut down. It was really as the system said, "With an axe in hand, I have wood."

At the beginning of the game, his territory was in the forest, and soon he got a wooden treasure chest, from which he opened an exquisite iron axe.

Two days later, he finally realized the secondary job of lumberjack by constantly chopping trees, and lived a life without worries about food and clothing.

Others can chop down a big tree in 10 minutes, but he can chop two in 1 minute.

Seeing the wood in the backpack, he smiled.

In the vast "fog well", most of the players are desperately collecting resources under the scorching sun.

They have experienced natural disasters and acid rain, and know the horror of this survival game. Before the next test comes, they must collect more resources. If they want to survive, they can only rely on themselves.

After "playing" in the mud for an hour, Wang Shuo's 70-grid backpack is almost full.

Although Wang Shuo took sun protection measures and was still in the swamp, Wang Shuo still felt a little unbearable and planned to go back to drink water and take a rest.

He didn't know if the big brother in the desert had been roasted.

In fact, the desert boss was mining in his iron ore cave and couldn't feel the heat in the desert at all.

Back in the shelter, Wang Shuo noticed that a part of the trap he dug for the elite crocodile collapsed.

The crocodile had already escaped.

There was no choice but to rethink how to deal with the crocodile.

Wang Shuo felt that as long as he was well prepared, he would have at least 90% chance of killing it.

Looking at the time, it was only 3 o'clock in the afternoon, and there was still plenty of time. He put the collected resources into the warehouse, drank a sip of water, and waited for his energy to recover.

Not long after, he set out again and headed for the flax field.

In the flax swamp, Wang Shuo had dug a small ditch 50 meters long and 2 meters wide. He planned to wait until the danger of the territory was cleared, and then connect this small ditch into a circle and use it as a "moat".

Then build a circle of "walls" around the "moat".

Half an hour later, Wang Shuo returned to the shelter again. This time, because he filled a lot of water, all the backpacks were quickly filled.

Putting the resources into the warehouse again, he got a total of 5,000 units of clay, 100 units of fish, 2,000 units of flax, and 800 units of flax seeds.

There were 4,000 units of water in the backpack.

He decided to make 2,000 bricks first and keep them for backup, and also made some other tools that might be useful.

After resting for a few minutes, when his mental power was fully restored, Wang Shuo began his plan to deal with the crocodile.

Wang Shuo gave his action plan a code name, "Operation No. 4".

He came to the trap of yesterday and used the skills of "mixing mud" and "making mud pits" to dig tunnels and traps.

For a strong enemy that cannot be confronted head-on, the advantage of terrain is particularly important.

Wang Shuo's territory is basically flat, and he must create a lot of terrain that is beneficial to him.

After another hour, Wang Shuo created a winding "U"-shaped passage.

2 meters wide and 6 meters deep, and then took out the earth bricks just made, and continuously reinforced some key places, some corners, and both sides of the "Z"-shaped channel, all of which were reinforced with earth bricks, so that the width was just enough to block the crocodile.

And he also opened some passages in the passage that could only accommodate one person, so that he could escape quickly.

Seeing this maze-like trench, Wang Shuo showed a satisfied smile. Such terrain can greatly restrict the huge crocodile with a length of 5 meters.

To be on the safe side, in the end, he also dug a small path leading directly to the door of the shelter.

The battlefield has been arranged. He looked to the south, the hometown of the crocodile, and said provocatively: "Little darling, let's play hide-and-seek together!"
